clips.title: The story
paras: At the forge in Darnassus, Mathiel's Armor brings night elf and dwarven craft together. Mathiel works in the Warrior's Terrace, using methods devised by Furen Longbeard to shape exotic materials into armor for Alliance warriors.

Night elf armorers have favored methods honed over millennia, with work shaped by nature, supple leathers, and carefully worked metals. Trade with the Eastern Kingdoms has led smiths such as Mathiel to try new ways. He brings the dwarven techniques devised by Furen Longbeard together with elven craft.

Mathiel needs sunscorched eggshells from the Highperch wyvern nests in Thousand Needles. He renders the sun-hardened shells into lacquer and uses Furen's heat-treatment formulas to forge resilient leggings for the front lines.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have finished with your piece of armor, and I am quite pleased. Furen's new techniques meshed perfectly with my own and I am sure this armor will prove to be quite resilient.
Thank you, friend. And may this serve you well in future battles.
